annotations.title: List One U Education advisors to talk to

description: One U Education's advisors, the same list as the "talk to an advisor" panel on www.oneuedu.com, so the user can choose a person to talk to: name, office, organisation, QEAC number, what each one handles, and how to reach them (WeChat Work link for Chinese, WhatsApp for English, and email). Pass topic, and studentLocation for study topics, to get the advisors the site recommends first. Use it when the user wants to talk to a person, a consultant or a specialist. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

language.description: Language the user wants to talk to the advisor in: zh = Chinese-speaking advisors on WeChat, en = English-speaking advisor on WhatsApp. Defaults to zh for zh-CN / zh-TW and en for en-US.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

studentLocation.description: Whether the user is inside (onshore) or outside (offshore) Australia. Some study advisors only look after one of the two.

topic.description: What the user wants to talk about: school (choosing schools and courses, applications, transfers), visa (visa applications), rpl (RPL and short courses), immigration (skilled migration, state nomination, skills assessment), cost-time (budget and timeline), technical (a problem with the oneuedu.com website), other. With a topic the advisors the site recommends come first, marked recommended.
